caption: Detection ends at 10 min and containment at 30 min, so the containment phase lasts only 20 min, yet the service stays down for a full 180 min until recovery.

spec.aria: An incident timeline in minutes: detect from 0 to 10, contain from 10 to 30, eradicate from 30 to 90 and recover from 90 to 180, with a second bar showing total downtime of 180 minutes from start to recovery.
